headline: How to keep Pal sanity high in Palworld
title: Keep Your Pals Happy | SAN Guide | Palworld Guide
video_script: Pals refusing to work in Palworld one point zero? Check their sanity. First, give every working Pal its own bed. Second, keep the Feed Box stocked, because food helps them recover. Third, build a Hot Spring, which guides call the key way to restore sanity. Also, don't leave the Monitoring Stand on super hard work all the time. Use it in short bursts. How do you keep your Pals happy? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 sanity guide: a bed for every working Pal, a stocked Feed Box, a Hot Spring, and no permanent super hard work mode.
